changelog:
- Initial release of the servicegraph skill.
- Provides a branded entry point for explicit ServiceGraph requests.
- Enables discovery and search of any ServiceGraph dataset through the API, with no hardcoded dataset or field assumptions.
- Supports both REST and MCP API usage for discovering datasets, exploring schema, searching, and unlocking data.
- Only unlocking rows spends credits; all other exploration is free.
- Includes guidance on authentication, cost confirmation, and intended usage scenarios.
